prior_packet_projection.note: Bootstrap of each team's real quarter scores. 'matchup_pair' includes the opponent's defence; 'independent' is the legacy sampler. No injuries, no weather, no fitted calibration. On 2026 weeks 1-8 neither sampler beat the market; treat probabilities near the market number as no information.
